name: CAPSULE
description: Opens .capsule sites: names that are their own key, pages no relay can read or forge.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'self' data:; child-src 'self' data:
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' data:; style-src 'unsafe-inline' data:; img-src data:; font-src data:; media-src data:; object-src 'none'; child-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
